query: Best achievable 2026 toolchain and operating procedure for autonomously building non-trivial multi-surface apps (and brownfield features) from a written specification, with architecture, UX, code and substantive unit/integration/E2E tests, asking the human only on genuinely blocking ambiguity.

operator.profile: solo developer/consultant, macOS, Claude Code primary harness (Opus-tier main session, tiered subagents, Serena MCP, token-optimizer, ~90 skills, ~33 agents)
stacks: Firebase (Cloud Functions, Firestore rules+indexes, Auth, Storage)

capability_bar_measured_2026_09_28.method: find/grep/wc over working tree, excluding node_modules, lib, dist, .next, build, _legacy; LOC = raw line counts of .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx
capability_bar_measured_2026_09_28.note: Both repos live inside the ~/dev/recovery-platform flat monorepo, so git history is shared (HEAD 1cf5147 at measurement time). Per-surface LOC and file counts are per-product and independent.

assumptions: No clarifying questions asked of the operator: budget ceiling, unattended-overnight tolerance, and local-vs-cloud execution were all inferable from the stated profile (budget-sensitive but pays for leverage; CLI-first local macOS; git-worktree comfortable). Stated here instead of asked, per the prompt's question budget.
Deliverables are written to ~/dev/research/app-dev/ per the operator's instruction, not to the skill's default ~/Documents/Claude/Research path.
'Non-trivial' is defined by the measured bar above: ~195k LOC, three surfaces, 400-950 line security-rule DSL files, 20-60 composite indexes, 100-220 mobile screens.

tooling_deviation.planned: Cowork built-in web search and web fetch only, per skill's tooling contract.
tooling_deviation.actual: WebSearch/WebFetch were not exposed to the orchestrating session (tool discovery returned no match). The orchestrator used the Firecrawl MCP search+scrape tools for verification fetches; retrieval subagents were instructed to prefer built-in WebSearch/WebFetch and fall back to Firecrawl. The fetch-before-quote rule was retained unchanged.
tooling_deviation.impact: Method-equivalent (real page retrieval, verbatim quotes, no snippet-only citations). Disclosed in the Methodology Appendix.

angles: A1 spec as source of truth
A13 ground truth on autonomy limits
A14 fit to this operator's stack
out_of_scope: no-code builders that cannot emit owned source into a git repo
prompt-engineering tips with no toolchain implication
